editor.run.description: Runs the statement under the cursor, or the selected SQL if there is a selection.

editor.runAll.description: Runs the entire script (all statements in the editor) as one batch.

editor.runToCursor.description: Runs every statement from the top of the script up to the cursor position.

editor.explain.description: Runs EXPLAIN on the current statement to show its query plan.

editor.goToObject.description: Jumps to the definition of the table (or object) named under the cursor.

editor.peekObject.description: Shows a quick inline peek of the DDL/definition for the object under the cursor without leaving the editor.

editor.aiGenerate.description: Opens the AI assistant to generate SQL from a natural-language prompt.

editor.aiExplain.description: Asks the AI assistant to explain the current statement in plain language.

editor.optimizerTrace.description: Runs a MySQL optimizer trace for the current statement to inspect how the optimizer chose its plan.

editor.prevStatement.description: Moves the cursor to the start of the previous SQL statement.

editor.nextStatement.description: Moves the cursor to the start of the next SQL statement.

editor.gotoLine.description: Prompts for a line number and moves the cursor to that line.

editor.matchingBracket.description: Jumps the cursor to the bracket matching the one at the cursor.

editor.replace.description: Opens the find-and-replace panel in the editor.

editor.format.description: Reformats the whole document using the active formatting profile.

editor.beautify.description: Beautifies just the current statement or selection using the active formatting profile.

editor.expandStar.description: Expands a SELECT * into the explicit list of column names.

editor.renameAlias.description: Renames a table alias or CTE and all its references in the statement.

editor.wrapInSubquery.description: Wraps the current statement in an outer SELECT * FROM (...) subquery.

editor.extractCte.description: Extracts the selected SQL into a named common table expression (CTE).

editor.selectNextOccurrence.description: Adds the next occurrence of the current selection to the selection for multi-cursor editing.

editor.selectAllOccurrences.description: Selects every occurrence of the current selection at once for multi-cursor editing.

editor.splitSelectionIntoLines.description: Splits the current selection into one cursor per line.

editor.toggleComment.description: Toggles line comments on the current line or selection.

editor.indentMore.description: Increases the indentation of the current line or selection.

editor.indentLess.description: Decreases the indentation of the current line or selection.

editor.lowerCase.description: Converts the selected text to lowercase.

editor.upperCase.description: Converts the selected text to UPPERCASE.

editor.pasteHistory.description: Opens the clipboard history to paste a previously copied entry.

editor.quickFix.description: Applies an available quick fix at the cursor (e.g. a suggested correction).

editor.moveLineUp.description: Moves the current line (or selected lines) up by one line.

editor.moveLineDown.description: Moves the current line (or selected lines) down by one line.

editor.copyLineUp.description: Duplicates the current line (or selection) above the original.

editor.copyLineDown.description: Duplicates the current line (or selection) below the original.

editor.deleteLine.description: Deletes the current line (or selected lines).

editor.joinLines.description: Joins the selected lines (or the current line and the next) into one.

editor.sortLinesAsc.description: Sorts the selected lines alphabetically in ascending order (A to Z).

editor.sortLinesDesc.description: Sorts the selected lines alphabetically in descending order (Z to A).

editor.sortLinesNumeric.description: Sorts the selected lines by their numeric value.

editor.dedupeLines.description: Removes duplicate lines from the selection, keeping unique lines.

editor.keepDuplicates.description: Keeps only the lines that are duplicated, removing lines that appear once.

editor.removeBlankLines.description: Removes blank/empty lines from the selection.

editor.trimTrailing.description: Trims trailing whitespace from the affected lines.

editor.reverseLines.description: Reverses the order of the selected lines.

editor.shuffleLines.description: Randomly shuffles the order of the selected lines.

editor.insertNumberSequence.description: Inserts an incrementing number sequence (e.g. across multiple cursors or lines).

editor.bookmarkToggle.description: Toggles a bookmark on the current line.

editor.bookmarkNext.description: Jumps to the next bookmark in the document.

editor.bookmarkPrev.description: Jumps to the previous bookmark in the document.

editor.macroRecordToggle.description: Starts or stops recording a macro of editor commands for later replay.

editor.wordWrap.description: Toggles word wrap in the current editor.

editor.zoomReset.description: Resets the editor font zoom to 100%.
